arguments.command:
python << 'EOF'
import parse

# Test trailing newline handling (R1)
r = parse.parse('hello\n', 'hello\n')
print(f'Trailing newline test:')
print(f'  parse("hello\\n", "hello\\n") = {r}')
if r:
    print(f'  -> matched successfully')

# Additional trailing newline tests with digit field numbering
r2 = parse.parse('{0}\n', 'test\n')
print(f'\nparse("{{0}}\\n", "test\\n") = {r2}')
if r2:
    print(f'  -> {r2[0]!r}')

# Digit field with type conversion and trailing newline
r3 = parse.parse('{0:d}\n', '42\n')
print(f'\nparse("{{0:d}}\\n", "42\\n") = {r3}')
if r3:
    print(f'  -> {r3[0]}')
    
# Mixed format specifiers
r4 = parse.parse('{0} {1:d}\n', 'hello 42\n')
print(f'\nparse("{{0}} {{1:d}}\\n", "hello 42\\n") = {r4}')
if r4:
    print(f'  -> {r4[0]!r}, {r4[1]}')
EOF
